questions.q: What are the three core principles of Stoicism?
questions.why: The text lists perception, action, and will as core principles.

questions.q: What does the book suggest doing with actions?
a: Control them, not let them control you

questions.q: How is will described in Stoic terms?
questions.why: Will is an inner power that helps endure hardships.

questions.q: What is the main goal of the Daily Stoic readings?
questions.why: The book offers daily readings to find happiness.
